correctness.rationale: The exact three-statistic update gives a martingale innovation with a finite-size correction 2W/[n(n+1)] in the centered recursion. Every transition identity and conditional variance identity was checked by complete exact-rational enumeration of recursive trees through eight vertices. The self-contained proof establishes L2 concentration of leaf fraction, L2 convergence of empirical depth variance divided by log n using Welford recursion and summable martingale noise, L2 control of C/n, predictable quadratic variation limit 1/12, conditional Lindeberg via exponential depth height bounds, and the final delta normalization giving variance 1/3. Finite checks do not constitute a proof of the CLT.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 work isolates the mean depth of actual leaves relative to all vertices as a natural statistic, but only gives its deterministic first-order limit. The sharp fluctuation rate and explicit variance reveal how overlapping global path-length randomness cancels while local leaf-conditioned depth noise remains. The n/log n scaling is not a routine consequence of the established first two limits and supplies a precise asymptotic uncertainty law for a genuine random-tree shape invariant.
